**Reference Entry**
Okafor, M. (2021). Coastal erosion and policy delay. *Journal of Shoreline Studies*, *14*(2), 201–225.

(Okafor, 2021, p. 214)

**Formatting Note**
The reference entry follows APA guidelines by listing the author's last name and initials first, placing the publication year in parentheses, using sentence case for the article title (only the first word and proper nouns are capitalized), and italicizing both the journal name and volume number while keeping the issue number in parentheses without italics. The in-text citation includes the author, year, and specific page number because it references a direct quote.
